senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to swing,] to be high, lifted up; to rise.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 24b">Ab. Zar. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>רוֹמִי רומי השיטה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>רוני</he>) rise, rise, acacia (holy ark)!; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 54:6">Gen. R. s. 54</cite> <he>רומי השטה</he>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 75:8">Ps. LXXV, 8</cite>) <he>ישפיל … ויָרִים לכרש וכ׳</he> he shall lower Belshazzar, and lift up Cyrus and Darius; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 812:1">Yalk. Ps. 812</cite> <he>אני הוא משפיל ומֵרִים</he> I lower and raise; <he>מלכות … מרים</he> he lays low one empire and raises another empire &c.; a. e.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:24">Ruth R. to I, 17</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 21:31">Ez. XXI, 31</cite>) <he>הסר … והָרִים העטרה וכ׳</he> remove the bonnet from our teachers, and take the crown off the nations; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be taken off, esp. to be separated as an offering, priest’s share &c.; to be consecrated.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Challah 2:8">Ḥall. II, 8</cite> <he>שלא הוּרְמָה חלתה</he> (not <cite ref="T00374"><he>הורם</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="H00988"><he>חַלָּה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 110:1">Sifré Num. 110</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 4:20">Num. IV, 20</cite>) <he>את שמוּרָם קודש וכ׳</he> that which is separated is to be sacred, and the remainder secular, but (no Ḥallah is to be taken,) when both would be sacred.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:6">Zeb. V, 6</cite> <he>המורם מהם וכ׳</he> the same rules apply to what is taken off them for the priest; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to lift up, elevate. Tanḥ. Matt. 6; Num. R. s. 22, end (ref. to Num. XXXI, 9 and XXXII, 1) הא שהשפיל … ור׳ וכ׳ here you see that the Lord lowered the Midianites, and raised the Israelites. Ib. (ref. to I Sam. II, 7) אף … מְרוֹמֵם את זה in the anger which he brings to bear on one, he raises the other.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 75:8">Ps. LXXV, 8</cite>) <he>משפיל לכל … ומרומם וכ׳</he> he lowered every one that had part in the worship of the golden calf, and elevated every one that had no part &c.

<cite ref="Psalms 75:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ועכשיו … אף כך רוֹמֵם ראשם</he> and now that thou hast lifted up my head, lift thou up their head likewise; <he>לך ר׳ ראשם</he> go and lift up their heads (announce to them the divine pardon).

<cite ref="Psalms 75:8">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 30:12">Ex. XXX, 12</cite>) <he>כל מה שאתה יכול לרוֹמֵם … רוֹמְמָהּ שבאילו לי אתה מְרוֹמֵם</he> (not <he>רומם</he>) in whatever way thou canst elevate that nation elevate it, for by this thou elevatest me.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 25:12">Ex. R. s. 25</cite> <he>ורִימְּמָן הקב״ה וכ׳</he> (fr. <cite ref="T00826"><he>רָמַם</he></cite>) and the Lord raised them above all; a. fr.

senses.gloss: , Nithpol. נִתְרוֹמֵם to be lifted up; to pride one’s self. Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵃ top יתגדל … ויתברך ויִתְרוֹמַם שמך וכ׳ thy Name be magnified … and blessed and lifted up (praised) for &c.; Y. Taan. I, 64ᵃ top; Gen. R. s. 13.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 17b:18">Meg. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון … מִתְרוֹמֶמֶת קרן וכ׳</he> when the transgressors cease to exist, the horn of the righteous will be uplifted.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 22:9">Num. R. s. 22</cite>; Tanḥ. Matt. 6, a. e. <he>אין אדם מִתְרוֹמֵם</he>, v. <cite ref="T00394"><he>רוֹמֵמוּת</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Mick. 3 <he>ונִתְרוֹמְמוּ</he> and they were raised (to power); a. e.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 79:3">Yalk.
